踩得一样快，为什么车速不同？: Same cadence. Why a different speed?
先踩起来，再换一个挡位看看。: Start pedalling, then try another gear.
后飞轮 · 大齿更省力，小齿更快: Rear sprocket · larger is easier, smaller is faster
每轮从零开始，以 60 rpm 试爬同一段 12 米教学坡道；曲柄扭矩上限 20: Each trial starts from rest at 60 rpm on the same 12 m teaching slope. Crank torque is limited to 20 N·m; the rear wheel requires 15 N·m. Shifting interrupts the current trial but keeps completed results. Start again clears all results.
踏频相同，不代表用力或功率相同。理想匀速条件，不计损耗、惯性或打滑；阈值为教学设: Equal cadence does not mean equal effort or power. The model assumes ideal steady motion, without losses, inertia or slipping. These teaching thresholds do not represent a real slope or fitness level. Timing counts simulated motion only; slow viewing, pauses and time away do not increase the result.
图里省略了什么？: What does this model leave out?
这是传动比教学台架，不是真实骑行仿真。速度表示能维持目标踏频时的理论值。轮周长设: This is a gear-ratio teaching rig. Speed is the theoretical value at the target cadence, with a 2.10 m wheel circumference.
飞轮、链条和后拨在三维空间中分层展示。换挡时示意链条选择对应飞轮；不模拟真实换挡: The sprockets, chain and derailleur are shown in separate 3D layers. Shifting illustrates the selected chain path; it does not simulate shift transients, spring forces, slipping or freewheeling. Wheel and gear dimensions are teaching proportions, not manufacturing drawings.
大飞轮降低同一轮端需求对应的曲柄扭矩，但不会凭空节省爬升的能量。: A larger rear sprocket reduces the crank torque needed for the same wheel torque. It does not reduce the energy required to climb.
拖动旋转 · 点踏板踩踏 · 点飞轮换挡 · 双击复位: Drag to rotate · click a pedal to start · click a sprocket to shift · double-click to reset
目标踏频，每分钟踩踏圈数: Target cadence, pedal revolutions per minute
立体自行车模型，拖动旋转，点击踏板开始，点击飞轮换挡: Dimensional bicycle model. Drag to rotate, click a pedal to start, or click a sprocket to shift.
点左侧挡位开始；只有到顶或转不动，才留下记录。: Select a gear to begin. A result is recorded only on reaching the top or stalling.
前齿盘带动链条，链条带动后飞轮。换挡改变前后齿数比，不会凭空产生能量。: The chainring moves the chain, which turns the rear sprocket. Shifting changes their tooth-count ratio; it does not create energy.
暂停，比较齿数与传动比: Paused. Compare the tooth counts and gear ratio.
